name: Joshua Rotenberg
headline: Technical Training & Development Specialist | Software Onboarding, Documentation & User Enablement
summary: Technical training and onboarding professional with 15+ years turning complex business software into training programs, documentation, and hands-on instruction that end users of varying technical experience can act on. Has developed sales and onboarding training curricula, led live and virtual technical onboarding for individual clients and high-volume partner networks, and built the user guides, workflow documentation, and reference materials that support them. Comfortable translating subject-matter expertise into structured training content and providing follow-up technical support after delivery.

Architect and implement complex CRM systems in GoHighLevel and HubSpot, including contact segmentation, lifecycle stages, and strict data-hygiene protocols.
